programme.title: Abadas
programme.desc: Ann an turas sgoinneil eile, tha Hari a' dol air tòir 'map'. Tha e a' lorg scutair agus frith-rathad fhad's a tha e ga lorg, ach am bi aige air 'map' fhaighinn agus faighinn a-mach dè tha e a' dèanamh? In another 'aba-doo-be-dee' adventure, Hari goes in search of a map. He comes across a scooter and a pathway as he explores the area, but will he be able to find out what a map looks like and what it does?

programme.title: Peicein/Petit
programme.desc: Tha Teàrlach a’ faireachdainn tinn is chan eil e airson cluich. Tha Peicein agus a charaidean a’ feuchainn ri bruidhinn ris, tha iad a’ teagasg an cànan fhèin dha, is a’ feuchainn ri cainnt nan con ionnsachadh iad fhèin. Tadeo is feeling sick and doesn't want to play. Petit and his friends try to communicate with him, teaching Tadeo human language and trying to learn dog talk themselves.

programme.title: Cleasan Ataidh & Tilidh/The Adventures of Abney & Teal
programme.desc: ‘S e latha socair a th’ ann air an eilean, latha math airson a bhith dìomhain. Tha Àtaidh, Tilidh agus Nìp a’ crochadh hamag, is tha tòrr spòrs aca a’ feuchainn ri faighinn oirre. Tha na Boga-bogadaich a’ feuchainn ri faighinn oirre cuideachd, ach tha iad air an caith suas dhan adhar is a’ dol a-mach à sealladh. Càite an deach iad? Tha Àtaidh, Tilidh agus Nìp a’ falbh a’ lorg nam Boga-bogadach. It is a lazy day on the Island. Abney, Teal and Neep put up a hammock and have a great time trying to get into it. The Poc-Pocs join in the fun but are thrown up into the air and disappear. Where have they gone? Abney, Teal and Neep go on a Poc-Poc hunt.

programme.title: Pompon Am Mathan Beag/Pompon Little Bear
programme.desc: Nuair a tha Pompon a’ faireachdainn nach eil sìon a' dol ceart dha, tha Dadaidh a' sealltainn dòigh dha air rudan a chur ceart! When Pompon feels that nothing is going right for him, Dadaidh shows him a way to sort things out!

programme.title: Sionnach agus Maigheach (Fox & Hare)
programme.desc: Tha Sionnach brònach nuair a chì e gun fheàrr le Maigheach a bhith a’ leughadh leabhar seach a bhith còmhla ris-san. Tha Tosg a’ moladh dhà e fhèin a chur ann an riochd ridire gaisgeil airson aire Maighich fhaighinn air ais. Tha an dithis aca a’ togail dràgon leis a’ bheachd gum faigh Sionnach buaidh air an dràgon, agus gun dearbh e a luach do Mhaigheach. When Hare would rather read her big book of fairytales than hang out with Fox, he fears he’s not exciting enough. According to Tusk, only by becoming a brave knight will Fox be able to prove the opposite is true. The two decide to build a dragon so Fox can beat it in battle and prove his worth to Hare.

programme.title: SpongeBob
programme.desc: Tha Mgr. Crùbag air a chlisgeadh mun sgrùdadh slàinte aige. Mr Krabs is too scared to get his physical.

programme.title: An Sgoil
programme.desc: Ged a tha na saor-làithean air tòiseachadh do sgoilearan Sgoil Taobh na Cloiche, tha latha a bharrachd aig an luchd-teagaisg airson beagan trèanaidh. Tha an t-eòlaiche-inntinn Sìleas Stern os cionn sheiseanan gus sìth agus càirdeas a stèidheachadh am measg an luchd-obrach. Although the holidays have started for the pupils of Sgoil Taobh na Cloiche, the teachers have an in-service day. Mr Mackle is keen to establish better relationships between his staff and has invited psychologist Sìleas Stern to run team building sessions that he hopes will bring peace and harmony.

programme.title: Calum: Cogadh nan Comhlan
programme.desc: Tha Calum airson a chòmhlann aige a thoirt à Glaschu dhan Òban airson blàr mòr ciùil a tha dol aig a' Mhòd Nàiseanta Rìoghail. Ach, le tòrr fharpaisean agus gainead tìde, chan eil cùisean a' dol mar bu chòir. Leis nach eil e furasda còmhlan a làimhseachadh aig na h-amannan as fheàrr, saoil ciamar a thèid dhaibh leis na dùbhlain mhòra a th' air thoiseach orra... Calum aims to take his band from Glasgow to Oban for a major musical battle at the Royal National Mòd. However, with numerous competitions and time constraints, things aren't going according to plan. Managing a band is never easy even in the best of times - how will they cope with the significant challenges that lie ahead?

programme.title: Oidhche Shamhna CBBC ALBA
programme.desc: Tanith Rothach le taghadh a tha eagalach fhèin math airson Oidhche Shamhna, le slaidhm, braimeannan agus taibhse no dhà cuideachd! Tanith Munro introduces some frighteningly good highlights for Halloween, with slime, farts and a ghost or two!

programme.title: An Là
programme.desc: Local, national and international news from BBC ALBA.

programme.title: Rurachd (Foraging)
programme.desc: Mary Ann Kennedy and Lucy Cooke are at home, stocking their cupboards with acorn flour, hedgehog mushrooms, juniper berries and angelica seeds for the winter.

programme.title: Faodail
programme.desc: Tha Tasglann Fhilm Faodail a’ tarraing aire gu filmichean dhùthchasach Innse Gall bho na 1930an gu na 80an, a bha caillte ach a-nis glèidhte don ghinealach ri teachd. Tha bhana Cinema Sgìre Leantainneach a’ siubhal nan eilean, a’ taisbeanadh fhilmichean sna sgìrean ionadail, le cothrom am faicinn air-loidhne air feadh an t-saoghail. Cuirear aithris bheairteach ùr riutha, a’ buntainn ris a’ Ghàidhealtachd, airson luchd-amhairc an là an-diugh. The Faodail Film Archive celebrates lost indigenous film collections from the 1930s-1980s in the Outer Hebrides, preserving the archive for future generations. The Cinema Sgìre Continuing mobile cinema van travels the islands showcasing footage to local communities, making them accessible globally online and adding rich new narratives relevant to the Gàidhealtachd for contemporary audiences. In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Samhradh air Sàl
programme.desc: Angus Mackay is joined by close friend Finlay Macleod from Scalpay for the final fishing trip of the season. With summer fading, the environment looks very different as the purple heather really comes to the fore. Tracked by the golden eagle, they sail north to the hamlet of Calbost to take advantage of the shelter offered by its bay on a less than optimal day. As the duo fish in the bay, they ponder the extremes of the sea - its matchless beauty and its mortal danger. Anns a’ phrògram mu dheireadh san t-sreath, tha Fionnlagh MacLeòid à Sgalpaigh, còmhla ri Aonghas airson an turas iasgaich mu dheireadh den t-seusan. Leis an samhradh a’ tighinn gu crìoch, tha an àrainneachd a’ coimhead gu math eadar-dhealaichte, ‘s am fraoch purpaidh a’ tighinn am follais. Air an leantainn le iolaire-bhuidhe, seòlaidh iad gu tuath, gu Calbost gus beagan fasgadh fhaighinn sa bhàgh, air latha meadhanach grod. Fhad ’s a tha iad ag iasgach, tha iad a’ meòrachadh air an dà chuid cunnart agus bòidhchead na mara.

programme.title: Seirm
programme.desc: Highlights and previously unseen performances, featuring Mairi McGillivary, Ciaran Ryan and Fara. Roghainn fon sreath ciùil comhla ri Màiri Nicillebhrath, Ciaran Ryan and Fara.

programme.title: Fonn mo Bheatha
programme.desc: Music and chat programme presented by Cathy Ann MacPhee, with guest Calum Alex MacMillan. Ceòl agus còmhradh le Cathy Ann Nic a Phi còmhla ri Calum Ailig MacMhaolain. In Gaelic with English subtitles

programme.title: Gàrraidhean Mòra na h-Alba
programme.desc: Murdo Macdonald explores Ardkinglas Gardens in Argyll. Murchadh Dòmhnallach a’cur eòlas air Gàrradh Àird Chonghlais ann an Earra-Ghaidheal.

programme.title: Dàna | Scotland's Wild Side
programme.desc: The vast landscape of the Cairngorms attracts thousands each year. Coinneach Rankin sets out on a multi-day expedition to learn why its vast mountains are a paradise for climbers, runners and so many others. Along with his partner, Coinneach races up one of the highest mountains in Scotland, undertakes a classic multi-pitch climb, and spends the night in a tiny bothy built in the 1960s. Tàlaidh cruth-tìre aibheiseach a’ Mhonaidh Ruaidh na mìltean gach bliadhna. Cuiridh Coinneach MacFhraing aghaidh air turas grunn làithean gus tuigsinn carson a tha sreapadairean, luchd-coise agus eile cho measail air na beanntan seo. An cuideachd deagh charaid, thèid Coinneach na dheann suas tè de na beanntan as àirde an Alba, dìreidh e slighe-sreapa fhada agus cuiridh e seachad na h-oidhche ann am bothan a thogadh ‘sna seasgadan. In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Rathad Ramsay
programme.desc: Ramsay meets Ian Smith in the village he was brought up, before they head along one of Tiree’s most famous beaches. As they walk along the coast, Ian reflects on his youth and the people that impacted him. Ian discusses how the Tiree music scene shaped him and brought him success as a box player, and he shares his passion for the island and his pride in setting up the only distillery in Tiree. San treas sreath de Rathad Ramsay bidh Ramsay MacMahon a’ coinneachadh ri sàr Ghàidheil bho air feadh Alba ‘s iad a’ co-roinn sgeulachdan, cuir luach air nàdar agus a’ cnuasachadh ma beatha. Coinnichidh Ramsay ri Iain Mac a’ Ghobhainn sa bhaile san d’rugadh e mas dèan iad air tè de na tràighean as iomraitiche ann an Tiriodh. Meòirichidh Iain air làithean òige agus na daoine bu mhotha a thug buaidh air a bheatha. Leis cho cudromach ‘s a tha ceòl air eilean Thiriodh, innsidh Iain man bhuaidh a bh’aige seo air fhèin agus mar a chuidich e a bhith cho soirbheachail le cluich a’ bhogsa. Bidh an dà chuid a mheas air an eilean agus a mhoit man aon taigh-stàile san eilean fhaighinn stèidhichte follaiseach. In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Ceol Sith
programme.desc: Come on a thrilling journey into the world of fairies and folklore with Ingrid Henderson. Thigibh air turas a-steach gu saoghal shìthichean agus creutairean os-nadarra eile le Ingrid NicEunraig.

programme.title: Ath-thogail Notre-Dame/Rebuilding Notre-Dame
programme.desc: In 2019, a catastrophic fire threatened Notre-Dame’s structure. Analysing the vaults of the building, researchers unveil its history and decipher the secrets of its past resistance.

programme.title: Abigail
programme.desc: 'S e th' ann am Brot fìor bhlast' de Choiridh leantail, ach lòn sònraicht' nach dìochuimhnich thu ann an cabhaig. An extremely delicious curried lentil soup is a special lunch which you won't forget in a hurry. In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: An Geam Àlainn
programme.desc: Ball-coise nam ban ann an Alba bho shealladh luchd-cluiche, luchd-leantainn & eòlaichean. Women’s football in Scotland seen through the eyes of players, fans and experts.

programme.title: Na Trads
programme.desc: Na Trads: An Dara Teud. Roghainn bho oidhche mhòr duaisean Na Trads 2023, a tighinn à Talla Caird, Dùn Dè. Le Màiri Anna NicUalraig agus Alistair Heather air an àrd-ùrlar agus air cùl stèids, coinneachaidh sin ris na luchd-ciùil agus na rionnagan a shoirbhich air an oidhche. Am measg na bhios a’ gabhail pàirt bidh Peatbog Faeries, Mànran, Joy Dunlop, Karine Polwart & Dave Milligan, Amy Laurenson, SC & T Youth agus an Robbie Shepherd Tribute. Highlights and music from the Trad Awards, from the Caird Hall, Dundee. Presenters Mary Ann Kennedy and Alistair Heather host the evening and we catch up with winners and stars of the event, both onstage and behind the scenes. Performances from Peatbog Faeries, Mànran, Joy Dunlop, Karine Polwart & Dave Milligan, Amy Laurenson, SC & T Youth and a musical tribute to a national treasure - the late Robbie Shepherd.

programme.title: Na Clangairean
programme.desc: Tha Meanbh is Beag ag adhbharachadh tubaist a tha a’ gabhail a-steach dìtheanan bulgach, am Moo-adhair, agus a’ Chearc Iarainn. Ciamar a thèid cùisean a cheartachadh? Meanbh and Beag cause an accident which involves bubble flowers, the Sky-Moo and the Iron Chicken. How will they get things sorted?

programme.title: Na Clangairean
programme.desc: Tha Beag tro chèile oir cha d' fhuair e air na solais iongantach fhaicinn nuair a bha e a-muigh ’g iasgach san long-chiùil. Dè nì Am Màidsear airson togail a thoirt do Bheag? Beag is upset when he misses seeing two spectacular lights whilst out fishing in the music boat. What will Am Màidsear do to cheer Small up?

programme.title: Creag nam Buthaidean/Puffin Rock
programme.desc: Tha Baba a' coinneachadh ri a charaid, Spiky, ach, chan eil Spiky airson cluich an-diugh - tha e troimh chèile 's e air a mhàthair a chall. Tha Baba cur roimhe Spiky a chuideachadh 's tha an dithis aca a' togail orra air turas-dàna! Baba is excited to meet his new friend Spiky, but Spiky doesn't want to play today as he has lost his mother and is very upset. Baba is determined to help and so the pair set off on an adventure to find her!

programme.title: Creag nam Buthaidean/Puffin Rock
programme.desc: Tha Oona 's Silky a' cur romhpa snàmh cuide ri na leumadairean ach tha Silky bochd a' tighinn an aghaidh creutair neònach a tha a' cur an dearg eagal orra! Tha an dithis a' dol gu Bernie gus faighinn a-mach dè seòrsa beathach a dh'fhaodadh a bhith ann. Oona and Sily's plan to spend the day swimming with dolphins is brought to a halt when a strange creature scares poor Silky witless. The pair visit Bernie to learn who, or what, this creature could possibly be.

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: Nuair a tha Bing a’ cluich geama le fòn-làimhe Flop, chaneil rudan a’ dol mar bu chòir oir tha am fòn-làimhe a' briseadh nuair a tha e dol na sgeing air an làr. An àite seo innse do Flop, tha Bing ga chuir dhan bhiona. Tha e faireachdainn cho dona mun seo ach tha e ag ionnsachadh gum feum e innse mar a thachair. When Bing is playing a game with Flop’s mobile phone, he accidentally drops the mobile and it breaks. Instead of telling Flop, he throws it in the bin. He feels upset about it all and learns that it’s best to tell the truth.

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: Nuair a tha Bing aig cuirm sa phàirc, tha còir aige 'n oidhch' a chrìochnachadh ach tha e air bhioran agus tha e fàs cho diùid. Ge-tà, le taic bho charaidean, tha e faighinn seachad air na duilgheadasan sin agus tha e a' seinn Òran a’ Bhogha-fhroise. When Bing is at a show in the park, he is extremely nervous as he is meant to be singing the finale. However, with help from his friends, Bing gets over all his insecurities and sings the Rainbow Song.

programme.title: Peicein/Petit
programme.desc: Tha Peicein is a charaidean gann de dh’airgead, is leis nach eil ann an airgead ach pìosan beaga pàipeir le dealbhan orra, tha iad uile a’ co-dhùnadh gun cruthaich iad an t-airgead aca fhèin, is gun ceannaich iad na thogras iad. Because they are a little short of money, and considering cash notes are only little papers with drawings on them, Petit and his friends decide to create their own money and buy anything they want.

programme.title: Hilda
programme.desc: Tha Hilda a’ dol gu coinneamh nan Sgùdan Sporais ’son a’ chiad turas, is tha bràiste ri chosnadh. Tha i fhèin ’s a caraidean dol a sgioblachadh sa phàirc. Chan eil gnothaichean ag obrachadh mar a shaoileadh tu, ge-ta! Hilda goes to a Sparrow Scouts meeting for the first time, and there is a badge to be earned. She and her friends tidy up in the park, but things don’t work out as you would imagine!

programme.title: A-null ’s a-nall
programme.desc: Nuair a tha aig Minho ri fuireach airson greiseag aig taigh Granaidh, chan eil a’ chùis ri còrdadh ris. Tha e taingeil, ge-tà, gu bheil Mango, a charaid, còmhla ris. When Minho has to stay at Granny’s for a while, he isn’t happy. He is, however, glad that his friend Mango is with him.

programme.title: Flix
programme.desc: Tha Flix 'son dearbhadh g’ eil easan na shàr chat feireil – dìreach mar athair, Zeno. Chan eil a nàmhaid, Burma, dol a dhèanamh chùisean furasta dha, ge-tà! Flix wants to prove that he’s an ultimate outdoor cat - just like his dad, Zeno. However his nemesis Burma isn’t going to make things easy for him!

programme.title: Seachd Là

programme.title: Alleluia!
programme.desc: Salm 69 air a sheinn le Calum Ailig Mac a' Mhaolain, an laoidh Solas Na Grèine le Ceathrar-cheòil Còisir Ghàidhlig Ìleach Ghaschu agus bidh Mairead MacFhionghain ag innse mun phàirt a th' aig creideamh na beatha fhèin. Tha am prògram air aithris le Iain MacFhionghain. Psalm 69 sung by Calum Alex MacMillan, the hymn Solas na Grèine by Glasgow Islay Gaelic Choir Quartet and Margaret MacKinnon tells her own personal faith story. Presented by Iain MacKinnon.

programme.title: Rùm Gu Rùm, Le Erica
programme.desc: Tha Erica Nic a’ Phearsain air ais a’ toirt cruth-atharrachadh àlainn air seòmaran agus toglaichean le a dealbhachadh sònraichte. Leanaidh sinn i bho thoiseach gu deireadh phròiseactan is sinn a’ faicinn gach pàirt den phròiseas, bho phlana air pàipear gu bhith a’ trusadh stuthan airson crìoch snasail a chur orra. Interior designer Erica MacPherson is back to transform more rooms, homes and businesses. We follow her process from architectural plans to trawling auction houses and shops for finishing touches. In Gaelic with English subtitles

programme.title: Sailm nan Daoine
programme.desc: Tha an ceòladair Rob MacNeacail air turas gus cumhachd seinn nan salm Gàidhlig a sgaoileadh. Musician Rob MacNeacail is on a mission to spread the power of Gaelic psalm singing.

programme.title: Skipinnish Aig A' Chaisteal
programme.desc: Skipinnish le The Atholl Set ann an cuideachd na mìltean de luchd-leantainn aig cuirm-chiùil a’ comharrachadh 25 bliadhna de Skipinnish, bho Chaisteal Dhùn Èideann. Skipinnish perform The Atholl Set in front of thousands of fans at a concert celebrating 25 years of the band, from Edinburgh Castle.

programme.title: Alba fon Talamh/Scotland Underground
programme.desc: In the Highlands and Islands, Calum explores the caves of Assynt, a Unesco global geopark, before travelling north to Orkney where there is a wealth of archeological underground sites. But it is also an example of the modern use of subterranean sites: oil to service the Scapa Flow naval sites was hidden underground in vast tanks beneath Wee Fea hill. The war theme continues as Calum visits a Cold War underground bunker in Inverness. Anns a’ Ghàidhealtachd agus na h-Eileanan, bheir Calum cuairt tro uamhan Asainte, geò-pàirc cruinneil UNESCO. À sin, thèid e tuath gu Arcaibh far a bheil beartas de làraich arceòlach fon talamh, ach cuideachd eisimpleir nas ùire den fho-thalamh a chleachdadh. Fo chnoc Wee Fea, tha na tancaichean mòra a bha a’ cumail ola ri làrach a’ Chabhlaich Rìoghail ann an Scapa Flow. A’ cumail ri tèama a’ chogaidh, ann an Inbhirnis tadhlaidh Calum air buncair bho àm a’ Chogaidh Fhuair. In Gaelic with English subtitles

programme.desc: An-diugh, tha Daolag-bhreac is Seillean a’ coinneachadh ri losgann is cinn-pholla bheaga. Today, Ladybird and Bee meet a frog and some small tadpoles.

programme.title: Creag nam Buthaidean/Puffin Rock
programme.desc: Tha Oona ‘s Otto a' cur romhpa a dhol a choimhead Leum a’ Bhradain ach mus fhaigh iad falbh, feumaidh Otto Pip ‘s Pop a chur dhan leabaidh às-dèidh an t-sealg-oidhch'. Ge-tà, chan eil e coltach g’ eil na cailleachan-oidhche bheaga idir sgìth. Oona and Otto decide to spend the morning watching the 'salmon leap' but before they can set off, Otto must put Pip and Pop to bed after the night hunt. Unfortunately for Otto, it doesnt seem that the young owls are in the least bit tired.

programme.title: Creag nam Buthaidean/Puffin Rock
programme.desc: Tha farspach a’ nochdadh air a’ chreag agus i ann an sunnd airson mi-mhodh. Ge-tà, nuair a dh’fheuchas i ri biadh a ghoid bho fhaoileag bhìodach, tha Oona ‘s Baba a' tighinn na h-aghaidh gus an t-ìsean a dhìon! The great gull has made her way to Puffin Rock and is intent on causing all sorts of mischief. However, when she sets her sights on a poor little seagul chick, Oona and Baba are ready to challenge her and protect the little bird!

programme.title: Boban is Fuigheag
programme.desc: Nuair tha Boban is Fuigheag a’ lorg spong copach, abair g’ eil spòrs aca leis na builgeanan beaga – tha Fuigheag dìreach na ghlòraidh. Ach uaireannan, feumar a cheannsachadh! When Boban and Fuigheag find a soapy sponge, they have a lot of fun with the little bubbles. Fuigheag is in his element, but sometimes he needs to calm down!

programme.title: Losgannan | Froglets
programme.desc: Nuair a lorgas Sif, Pipp agus Bran sreang-fhiacaill, tha farpais tarraing ròpa air fàire! Ziff, Pipp and Button discover dental floss and plan an exciting tug-of-war showdown!

programme.title: Sionnach agus Maigheach (Fox & Hare)
programme.desc: Nuair a chì Sionnach mar a tha Feòrag air a beò-ghlacadh le na saor-làithean mìorbhaileach aice anns a’ choille, tha e fhèin airson a dhol air saor-làithean. Chan eil Maigheach cho cinnteach mun chùis. Cò choimheadas às dèidh a’ bhothain agus a’ ghàrraidh? Cò ach Tosg is Comhachag! Carson nach rachadh an dithis aca-san air saor-làithean mìorbhaileach anns a’ bhothan? Saoil dè cho mìorbhaileach ’s a bhios na saor-làithean aca uile? Brush really enjoys her holiday in the forest, which makes Fox want to go on one as well! Hare isn’t so sure - who will take care of their den and garden? Well, Tusk and Owl of course! programme.desc: Tha sinn air ais ann an Sgoil Taobh na Cloiche airson teirm ùr. Tha tòrr air tachairt thairis air na saor-làithean. Cha robh an là in-sheirbheis cho soirbheachail `s a bha Maighstir Mackle an dùil agus tha Ms Sharpe air nochdadh sna pàipearan-naidheachd ri linn ‘s na thachair aig a’ Mhòd. Our cameras are back at Sgoil Taobh na Cloiche for a new term. A lot has happened over the holidays. The in-service day wasn’t as successful as Mr Mackle had hoped and Ms Sharpe has made the newspapers after what happened at the Mòd.

programme.desc: Tha na Gumbalan uabhasach trang 's iad ri buain na dearc-choille uaine – ach Troig a-mhàin! Chan eil aire-san air na gnothaichean a bha 'n urra ris idir, idir. 'S ann a tha esan a' cur a’ charaidean ann an cunnart! The Gumbals are very busy, harvesting greenberry - except for Troig! He has lost all interest in what he was meant to be doing. In fact, he puts his friends in danger!

programme.title: Bogaisean is Gumbalan/Bottersnikes and Gumbles

There’s a horrible smell from Troig, Bonns and Uilidh when they bet one another to eat chill-grubs - so awful that the smell sends the Bògaisean doolally!

Le Niall Iain Dòmnallach aig an stiùir cluichidh na sgiobaidhean anns an stiùideo an aghaidh an ochdnar Mas Fhìoraich a tha a’ cluich bhon dachaighean fhèin agus a tha a’ cur nan ceistean. A’ strì an aghaidh na Mas Fhìoraich airson feuchainn air an duais mhòr, tha Ewen is Jonny agus Marley is Denise. Presented by Niall Iain MacDonald, this is the quiz show where more than general knowledge is required to win. Playing from the comfort of their own homes are the Pretenders, and they are the ones posing the questions! Battling them to win the big prize in the studio are Ewen and Jonny, and Marley and Denise. programme.desc: Le ball-coise ann an Alba ann an staing le gainnead chluicheadairean òga a’ faighinn chothroman, tha an SFA airson crathadh a thoirt air na riaghailtean aca. Tha Calum MacIllinnein a’ rannsachadh nam planaichean, a’ coinneachadh ri clubaichean, cluicheadairean is luchd-leantainn, is a’ faighneachd dè thèid again air ionnsachadh bho shiostam Nirribhidh. As Scottish football faces a crisis over its pipeline of talent, the SFA are planning an overhaul of youth development. Calum Maclennan examines the plans, meeting clubs, players and fans, and asks what we can learn from Norway’s system. In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: An Clo Mor
programme.desc: It’s make or break time at the Hebridean family-run tweed mill, ‘Muileann Mhicsuain’. Time is running out for mill owner Seumas as he tries to save his business, but his corner-cutting has horrific consequences. A dreadful accident takes place on the mill floor that endangers the life of a beloved employee, Old Mary. With the family business in jeopardy, Seumas makes a secret phone call asking for help, but who is he reaching out to and why does he have to keep it secret from his family? Tha taghaidhean mòra air thoiseach orra aig Muileann MhicSuain, a’ mhuileann chlò Innse Gall a th’ air a ruith le teaghlach MhicSuain. Tha an ùine a’ ruith air ceannard na muilne, Seumas, agus e a’ dèanamh nas urrainn dhà gus a’ ghnìomhachas aige a shàbhaileadh – ach tha cùisean a’ tighinn gu ceann uabhasach ri linn an dòigh-obrach charach aige. Tha tubaist eagalach a’ tachairt air làr na muilne a tha a’ cur beatha tè dhen luchd-obrach, Màiri, ann an cunnart. Le gnìomhachas an teaghlaich fo imcheist, tha Seumas a’ cur a dh’iarraidh cuideachadh – ach cò dhà a tha e a’ faighneachd agus carson a dh’fheumas e a chumail bhon chòrr dhen teaghlach? In Gaelic with English subtitles

programme.desc: Ann an saoghal làn gleadhraich, ciamar a tha beathaichean a’ dèanamh ciall dheth? In a world filled with noise, how do animals make sense of it all?

An uair sin tha beachd aig Tilidh, is tha i a’ moladh gun tèid iad uile air turas timcheall an eilein air fad. ’S e turas air leth a th’ ann, gus an tig rudeigin nan rathad! Everybody is bored. Abney builds a train so they can go on a tour. Then Teal has an idea: why don’t they tour the whole island? It is a fantastic tour until something gets in the way!

programme.desc: When a penguin takes a shine to Stink's bed, and Grumblestunk decides to open a zoo, Brody is unimpressed, so Stan and Gran are forced to investigate! Nuair a tha ceann-fionn a' gabhail nòisean den leabaidh aig Samh, 's tha Greannarlobht a' cur roimhpe sù fhosgladh, chan eil Murchadh air a dhòigh, 's le sin, chan eil roghainn aig Dan is Gran ach teannadh ri rannsachadh!

programme.desc: Aig Coinneamh nam Pàrant, tha Hilda ag ionnsachadh g’ eil creag bhon Chruinneachadh Nàdair aig Dàibhidh neo-àbhaisteach is, ri linn sin, tha 'd uile ann am fìor chunnart At the parents’ meeting, Hilda learns that one of Daibhidh’s rocks from his nature collection is out of the ordinary. But it puts them all in great danger.

programme.title: Stri
programme.desc: Tha preasantairean CBBC ALBA uabhasach fhèin measail air dùbhlain ach saoil cò shoirbhicheas is Hannah a’ tadhal orra? The CBBC ALBA presenters love a good challenge, but who will emerge victorious as Hannah joins them?

programme.title: A-null ’s a-nall
programme.desc: Nuair a tha Nidza a’ cluich ball-coise le charaidean, chan eil cùisean a’ dol mar bu chòir oir the e ga fhaighinn fhèin glaiste ann an seilear is dearg-eagal aige bhon dorchadas! When Nidza plays football with his friends, things don’t go his way as he finds himself locked in a cellar and he’s petrified of the dark!

programme.title: Geamaichean Gorach
programme.desc: Bodach-sneachd, rabaid, curran, Coinneach Clogaid agus beagan draoidheachd – abair measgachadh! Coinneach Clogaid, a rabbit, a carrot and a little magic - what a combination!

programme.title: Geamaichean Gorach
programme.desc: Càit’ an stad Coinneach Clogaid leis a dhroch-ghiùlain? Bheil càil idir ann nach fheuch e? Ge-tà, chaneil dòigh air thalamh gum faigh e às leis! Where will Coinneach Clogaid stop with his bad behaviour? Is there anything that he won’t try? There is no way that he will get away with it though!

programme.title: Seòid a' Chidsin - The Kitchen Coves
programme.desc: Tha oidhche Shathairne tric a’ ciallachadh ‘takeaway’, ach tha na seòid a’ sealltainn dhuinn gun gabh biadh ‘chippy’ a dhèanamh aig an taigh cuideachd. Tha Ruairidh a’ dèanamh iasg blasta le taois-leanna fhad ’s a tha Ùisdean ag ullachadh tiops air am bruich dà thuras. Tha Ùisdean an uairsin a’ dèanamh Scampi agus ‘Clampi” ann an taois tempura le tiops air am bruich trì tursan! Tha Ruairidh a’ dèanamh Coleslaw a thèid còmhla ris agus cuideachd sabhs spìosrach. Gus crìoch a chur air a’ phrògram, tha Ùisdean a’ dèanamh donut reòiteig, le Ruairidh a’ dèanamh sabhs caramail airson a ghabhail còmhla ris. Saturday nights often mean takeaway dinners, but the lads show us that excellent 'chippy' food can be made at home, too. Ruaridh cooks a tasty beer-battered fish while Uisdean prepares twice cooked chips to go with it. Uisdean then makes Scampi and 'Clampi' in tempura batter accompanied by thrice-cooked chips! Ruaridh creates a coleslaw and a spicy dipping sauce as an addition. Uisdean then makes an ice cream doughnut while Ruaridh cooks a caramel sauce to go with it. In Gaelic with English subtitles

programme.title: SpeakGaelic
programme.desc: Long-time learner Rick Rennie joins Joy in the studio and Calum Maclean is in Argyll exploring the historic township of Auchindrain.

programme.title: An Là
programme.desc: Naidheachdan ionadail, nàiseanta is eadar-nàiseanta gach là cuide ri fiosrachadh coimhearsnachd bho BBC ALBA. Local, national and international news and information from BBC ALBA.

programme.title: Rùm Gu Rùm, Le Erica
programme.desc: Actress turned interior designer Erica Macpherson takes us on a design adventure throughout the Highlands and Islands. With the help of local craft workers, she finds new ideas for designing old spaces. Tha an cleasaiche, a tha a-nis na dealbhaiche cruthachail thaighean, Erica Nic a’ Phersain, a’ gabhail sgrìob tron Ghàidhealtachd ‘s na h-Eileanan. Le taic bho luchd-ciùird, tha i a’ lorg dhòighean ùra air seann rumanan a thoirt beò. In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Alba fon Talamh/Scotland Underground
programme.desc: Calum explores the underground sites of central Scotland. First, author Mairi Kidd introduces him to a lesser known history of Edinburgh below the city streets. Then he ventures under the busy platforms of Glasgow Central Station, where Calum discovers an atmospheric disused Victorian platform. In Dunoon, Calum gets help from his friend Kenny Rankin to access the Paper Caves and find out more about a story that dates back almost 350 years, connecting the Campbell clan with the site. ’S a’ phrògram mu dheireadh, nì Calum rannsachadh air làraich fon talamh ann am meadhan na h-Alba. Innsidh an t-ùghdair, Màiri Kidd, dha mun eachdraidh fo shràidean Dhùn Èideann air nach eil mòran eòlach. Fo àrd-ùrlairean trang Stèisean Rèile Meadhan Ghlaschu, gheibh Calum lorg air àrd-ùrlar iongantach, neo-chleachte bho linn Bhictòiria. Ann an Dùn Omhain, bheir a charaid, Coinneach MacFhraing, cuideachadh do Chalum gus Uamhan nam Pàipear a ruighinn agus tuilleadh ionnsachadh mu sgeulachd bhon t-seachdamh linn deug a tha a’ ceangal na Caimbeulaich ris an t-sreath uamhan seo. In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Rurachd (Foraging)
programme.desc: Mary Ann Kennedy and Lucy Cooke are at home, stocking their cupboards with acorn flour, hedgehog mushrooms, juniper berries and angelica seeds for the winter.

programme.desc: Music and chat programme presented by Cathy Ann MacPhee, with guest Calum Alex MacMillan. Ceòl agus còmhradh le Cathy Ann Nic a Phi còmhla ri Calum Ailig MacMhaolain. In Gaelic with English subtitles

programme.title: Alleluia!
programme.desc: Salm 69 air a sheinn le Calum Ailig Mac a' Mhaolain, an laoidh Solas Na Grèine le Ceathrar-cheòil Còisir Ghàidhlig Ìleach Ghaschu agus bidh Mairead MacFhionghain ag innse mun phàirt a th' aig creideamh na beatha fhèin. Tha am prògram air aithris le Iain MacFhionghain. Psalm 69 sung by Calum Alex MacMillan, the hymn Solas na Grèine by Glasgow Islay Gaelic Choir Quartet and Margaret MacKinnon tells her own personal faith story. Presented by Iain MacKinnon.

programme.title: Disco: Soundtrack of a Revolution
programme.desc: At the end of the 1970s, the founding principles of disco – queerness, diversity and feminism – were coming under increasing attack from a predominantly white, straight, rock-loving audience. By the summer of 1978, disco appeared untouchable, but mass marketing and rampant commercialism were beginning to turn the tide. A glut of bad disco singles and the perceived elitism of clubs like Studio 54 fuelled a surge in anti-disco feeling. This is the story of how disco died - and where it went.

programme.title: Sounds of the Seventies
programme.desc: Disco was all pervasive in the mid and early 70s. And while towards the end of the decade punk stole the headlines, disco still had the high street. Everyone was into it and getting down on it at the local discotheque. Join us in a celebration of all things disco including performances by The Jacksons, Thelma Houston, Sylvester, Carl Douglas, George McCrae, Sister Sledge, McFadden and Whitehead, Eruption and Gloria Gaynor.

programme.title: Top of the Pops
programme.desc: Julian Clary presents the pop chart programme, first broadcast on 1 November 1996 and featuring Reef, Livin' Joy, Alisha's Attic, Madonna, Space, Wham!, Toni Braxton, Jimmy Nail, East 17 featuring Gabrielle and Spice Girls.

programme.title: Top of the Pops
programme.desc: David Hamilton presents the pop chart programme, first broadcast on 29 July 1979 and featuring Thin Lizzy, Chanter Sisters, Liverpool Express, Jimmy James and the Vagabonds and dance sequences from Ruby Flipper.

programme.title: Top of the Pops
programme.desc: Jamie Theakston presents the pop chart programme, first broadcast on 7 July 2000 and featuring Kylie Minogue, Lonyo, Samantha Mumba, Coldplay, Vengaboys, Sid Owen, Robbie Williams, Five & Queen and Eminem.

programme.title: Fungi: The Web of Life
programme.desc: Much of life on earth is connected by a vast, hidden network that we are only just beginning to understand. Out of sight, between the world of plants and animals, another realm exists - the kingdom of fungi. Passionate biologist and writer Merlin Sheldrake travels the globe, exploring the secret world of fungi. Through dazzling images of fungi under the microscope and all around us in the forest, Merlin unravels the many secrets of these essential organisms. So much more than mushrooms, not only do fungi shape the weather and support life on land, they are also at the cutting edge of medical research and even have the power to break down plastic waste. This film takes us from the ancient Tasmanian Tarkine rainforest to the mystical wilds of China’s Yunnan Province, in search of solutions to some of our planet’s biggest challenges. Can the answers be found in the wonderful world of fungi?

programme.title: Full Circle with Michael Palin
programme.desc: Michael Palin undertakes a journey around the Pacific Rim through 18 countries. Arriving in Qingdao, Michael checks into his hotel - which is curiously like a Bavarian castle - and finds himself in a room that was once Chairman Mao's. Having climbed China's holiest mountain, he travels to Shanghai to see the new face of the nation, then takes a steamboat trip on the Yangtze River

programme.title: Miss Marple
programme.desc: While the investigation centres on the Jefferson family and their entourage, Miss Marple's hunch about a second killing proves all too tragically justified.

programme.title: Fanny and Alexander
programme.desc: Ingmar Bergman’s dreamlike chronicle of an extended family in early 20th-century Sweden. One tumultuous year in the life of the Ekdahl family is viewed through the eyes of ten-year-old Alexander, whose imagination fuels the magical goings-on leading up to and following the death of his father. When his mother marries a stern bishop, Alexander and his sister Fanny are banished to a gothic world.

programme.title: Arena
programme.desc: Film-maker Ingmar Bergman shows us his world on the desolate and mysterious Baltic island of Faro. In his home at the seashore, he talks about the childhood that shaped him and speaks of how the art of film was often a comfort to him. He tells, too, of love and death, and lists his worst demons.

programme.title: To the Manor Born

programme.title: Keeping Up Appearances
programme.desc: Hyacinth has decided that, instead of her usual gift to Richard of slippers, he should receive skis instead. When Richard protests that he has no intention of taking up the sport, Hyacinth responds that he can cultivate the correct image by strapping them atop the car and drive about with them occasionally.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow
programme.desc: On one of the wettest days in Roadshow history, over 2,000 visitors queue to see Fiona Bruce and the experts sheltering under the canopy at Minehead station, which is run by West Somerset Railway. Objects brought to camera include a bracelet made from jewels once owned by the last of the Romanovs, the Russian royal family, photographs from the day The Beatles came to film A Hard Day's Night and a bronze by sculptor Rodin.

programme.title: A Stitch in Time
programme.desc: Fusing biography, art and the history of fashion, Amber Butchart explores the lives of historical figures through their clothes. She looks at Marie Antoinette.

programme.title: Pubs, Ponds and Power: The Story of the Village
programme.desc: Archaeologist Ben Robinson unlocks the ancient roots of the Northumberland village of Warkworth. With the help of locals, he discovers clues that point back almost 1,000 years to the Norman conquest when the invaders laid the foundations of a planned community, still visible to this day.

programme.title: Shakespeare: Rise of a Genius
programme.desc: Shakespeare’s life and legacy is threatened when the Gunpowder Plot unearths a secret he has worked all his life to bury: his family are Catholics, traitors to the crown. When his daughter is implicated in the fallout, Shakespeare unleashes his most epic work to date: Macbeth, which appeals to the new monarch, King James I. As Shakespeare teeters towards death, he reflects on his successes and failures, questioning family, forgiveness and mortality as his work is at risk of being lost forever.

programme.title: The BBC Television Shakespeare
programme.desc: A set of television adaptations of all 37 plays by William Shakespeare.

programme.title: Peace in No Man's Land
programme.desc: The story of the Christmas truce On Christmas Eve 1914 on the Western Front, British and German soldiers sang carols to each other across a frosty, moonlit No Man's Land. The next morning, on Christmas Day, hundreds of men of both nations emerged from the trenches to talk, joke, take photographs and exchange souvenirs, in the most famous fraternisation of the First World War. This remarkable event is remembered by three soldiers who took part: Graham Williams of the London Rifle Brigade, Leslie Walkinton of the Queen's Westminster Rifles and Albert Moren of The Queen's Regiment.

programme.title: A Stitch in Time
programme.desc: Fusing biography, art and the history of fashion, Amber Butchart explores the lives of historical figures through their clothes. She looks at Marie Antoinette.

programme.title: Shakespeare: Rise of a Genius
programme.desc: Shakespeare’s life and legacy is threatened when the Gunpowder Plot unearths a secret he has worked all his life to bury: his family are Catholics, traitors to the crown. When his daughter is implicated in the fallout, Shakespeare unleashes his most epic work to date: Macbeth, which appeals to the new monarch, King James I. As Shakespeare teeters towards death, he reflects on his successes and failures, questioning family, forgiveness and mortality as his work is at risk of being lost forever.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow
programme.desc: On one of the wettest days in Roadshow history, over 2,000 visitors queue to see Fiona Bruce and the experts sheltering under the canopy at Minehead station, which is run by West Somerset Railway. Objects brought to camera include a bracelet made from jewels once owned by the last of the Romanovs, the Russian royal family, photographs from the day The Beatles came to film A Hard Day's Night and a bronze by sculptor Rodin.

programme.title: Alaska: Earth's Frozen Kingdom
programme.desc: Three-part series that looks at a year in Alaska, revealing the stories of pioneering Alaskans, both animal and human, as they battle the elements and reap the benefits of nature's seasonal gold rush.

programme.title: The Story of Scottish Art
programme.desc: The story of Scottish art and its impact on the international art world is celebrated in this four-part series presented by acclaimed artist Lachlan Goudie. The series spans 5,000 years of Scotland's history, from the earliest Neolithic art to the present day. In the first programme, Lachlan explores Scotland's earliest art. He visits the Ring of Brodgar in Orkney, where standing stones have watched the seasons pass for thousands of years. On the island of Westray he encounters an ancient figurine - the Westray Wife - the oldest sculpted human figure in the British Isles. He explores the sophisticated art of the Picts and the Gaels, the exuberant Renaissance period of the early Stewart kings, and the destructive heights of the Reformation, when religious artworks were all but wiped out in Scotland.

programme.title: Classic Mastermind
programme.desc: Magnus Magnusson presents the quiz programme from Surrey University. The specialist subjects are the novels of Anthony Powell, the Byzantine Empire in the age of Justinian, the life and works of Giuseppe Verdi and WE Gladstone.

programme.title: Call My Bluff
programme.desc: Panel game of word definitions and deceptions hosted by Robert Robinson. Team captains Frank Muir and Patrick Campbell are joined by Arthur Marshall, David Hunt, Pauline Collins and Gabrielle Drake.

programme.title: John Berger: The Art of Looking
programme.desc: Film exploring the life and work of the late writer and art critic John Berger. The film is an intimate portrait of a man who has shaped our understanding of the concept of seeing.

programme.title: Metalworks!
programme.desc: Dan Cruickshank visits Britain's finest country houses, museums and factories as he uncovers the 18th- and 19th-century fascination with silver. Delving into an unsurpassed era of shimmering opulence, heady indulgence and conspicuous consumption, Dan discovers the Georgian and Victorian obsession with this tantalising precious metal which represented status, wealth and excellent taste. He gives us a glimpse of some of the most extensive collections and exquisite pieces of silverware to have ever been made on British shores.

programme.title: An Art Lovers' Guide
programme.desc: Janina Ramirez and Alastair Sooke discover the art and design of Amsterdam - a city that pioneered much of modern life, from multinational trade to how we design our homes.

programme.title: Secrets of Skin
programme.desc: Why are male mandrill faces (big bold primates from West Africa) red and blue? How are birds' feathers so colourful? What do ringtail lemurs do to talk to one another? Their skin holds the key. As Professor Ben Garrod explores how animals communicate with one another, he uncovers a myriad more wonderful ways. Skin has evolved in some remarkable ways to enable animals to communicate with each other, from vibrant displays of colour to skin pouches to amplify sound. Ben shows how animals have evolved to use skin to make themselves heard loud and clear. Birds are notable for their use of coloured feathers to attract mates, show status and as displays of aggression. But, as Ben discovers, long before birds evolved their unrivalled use of colour, it is now believed that their ancestors, the dinosaurs, could well have been using colour to communicate. Ben also uncovers how one species of fish communicates using electricity, and a common British bird has been secretly communicating for years, without us ever knowing.

programme.title: Weatherman Walking
programme.desc: In the first of two special walks celebrating the centenary of Dylan Thomas's birth, Derek Brockway walks in Dylan's footsteps around his home town of Swansea. With his guide, actor Adrian Metcalfe, Derek sets off from Dylan's childhood home on Cwmdonkin Drive. He then walks through the city's beautiful parks and down to the seafront before visiting some of Dylan's haunts in later life. Derek even gets to end his walk with a pint! He then heads west to the Llansteffan Peninsula where his guide, artist Osi Rhys Osmond, leads him through the beautiful countryside which was home to many of Dylan's relatives. They visit his aunt's farm, which would provide the inspiration for Dylan's poem Fernhill, before dropping down to the stunning Three Rivers estuary where the Taf, Tywi and Gwendraeth meet.

programme.title: To the Manor Born
programme.desc: British Rail decides to close down the local station, and Audrey goes into battle.

programme.title: Keeping Up Appearances
programme.desc: Sitcom. Richard is worried that Hyacinth's attendance at an exclusive auction is going to cost him a lot of money. However, he ends up with a very different problem.

programme.title: The Normans
programme.desc: Professor Robert Bartlett explores the impact of the Normans on southern Europe and the Middle East. The Normans spread south in the 11th century, winning control of southern Italy and the island of Sicily. There they created their most prosperous kingdom, where Christianity and Islam co-existed in relative harmony and mutual tolerance. It became a great centre of medieval culture and learning. But events in the Middle East provoked the more aggressive side of the Norman character. In 1095, the Normans enthusiastically answered the pope's call for holy war against Islam and joined the first crusade. They lay siege to Jerusalem and eventually helped win back the holy city from the Muslims. This bloody conquest left a deep rift between Christianity and Islam which is still being felt to this day.

programme.title: Storyville
programme.desc: A Storyville documentary that follows Syrian film-makers Hasan Kattan and Fadi Al-Halabi. Having forged a friendship while living through, and filming, the war in Syria, they now face a very different reality as they navigate the UK asylum system. Turning the camera on themselves, they document a new chapter in their own lives shaped by uncertainty, bureaucracy and displacement, offering a deeply personal and very raw exploration of friendship and belonging. This heart-wrenching film offers an intimate perspective on life in exile and the enduring power of storytelling in the face of adversity.

programme.title: Storyville
programme.desc: Vladimir Kara-Murza is a prominent Russian opposition politician and Pulitzer Prize-winning journalist who survived two near-fatal poisonings before being sentenced to 25 years in prison after speaking out against Russia’s invasion of Ukraine. This documentary short follows his wife, Evgenia Kara-Murza, during his imprisonment as she mounts a global campaign to bring him home and ensure that his voice would not be silenced.

programme.title: Secrets of Size: Atoms to Supergalaxies
programme.desc: In this mind-bending film, Jim Al-Khalili explores the universe at its smallest, from tiny insects to living cells and viruses, before finally arriving at the atom.

programme.title: Clive Myrie's African Adventure
programme.desc: In the second leg of his Ghanaian adventure, Clive heads 80 miles from the capital city of Accra to the picturesque fishing ports of Cape Coast and Elmina, where he digs deep into his ancestral roots. He takes part in one of Ghana's most exciting tribal celebrations as he’s welcomed by the Fante people. He's given a new name by elders from the group, as well as a personalised Fante flag that celebrates both his West African and Jamaican roots. As part of this journey, Clive makes a difficult but moving visit to a former slave fort to discover some of what his ancestors went through. And, in a personal first, Clive gets to dance in a hip-hop video with rising star Kojo Vypa.

programme.title: AI Decoded
programme.desc: AI Decoded examines the growing role of artificial intelligence in the US midterm elections. From AI-generated political adverts and deepfake videos to chatbot election advice and algorithm-driven feeds, AI is now embedded in every stage of the information ecosystem. Political campaigns are using AI to create content faster and cheaper than ever before. At the same time, convincing fake videos, synthetic ads and coordinated bot networks are making it harder for voters to separate fact from fiction. With millions of people now turning to chatbots for political information, are we entering an era where AI doesn't just influence elections, but shapes how voters understand them?

programme.desc: Talking Movies looks at the films that made waves at the BFI London Film Festival and the New York Film Festival in October. programme.title: The Media Show
programme.desc: This week the BBC announced more cuts as part of its drive to save £500 million, following on from a series of other budget saving measures over the last few months. Katie and Ros take stock of everything announced so far along with a panel of experts: ex-BBC executive Roger Mosey, MP for Southport Patrick Hurley, Baroness Morgan, former Secretary of State for Digital, Culture, Media and Sport and the BBC Deputy Director General Rhodri Talfan-Davies. And a new Channel 4 programme investigates public attitudes toward disability. The creators of The Experiment have built a fictional care home for disabled people and invite members of the public into the facility to see if they can recognise Nazi-era concepts disguised as modern social care. Producer Nick Parnes and presenter Sophie Morgan join the show.

programme.title: Talking Business
programme.desc: Why are record amounts of money pouring into sport? The LA Lakers are starting the new NBA as the most expensive sports team in history after being bought for $12.5bn. Record sums have also been spent on the NFL's Seattle Seahawks and English Premier League teams Liverpool and Chelsea in recent weeks. Is it really being driven by the search for an AI proof investment? Sal Galatioto is the man billionaires call when they want to buy or sell a sports team and he explains why the prices keep on climbing. Leading TV sports rights executive Daniel Cohen, of Octagon Global Media Consulting, explains the impact this is all having on how we watch and how much we pay. Ben Thompson also hears from the billionaire founder and CEO of Fanatics, Michael Rubin, and how fans are continuing to splash out on replica shirts, trading cards and other merchandise.

We also trace the roots of Yemen's war, exploring how the country's strategic location has drawn it into a struggle involving Saudi Arabia, Iran and the United States. Plus: BBC Mundo travels to Panama's Coiba Island, a biodiversity hotspot, to explore how a former prison colony helped preserve a rare and fragile natural world.

programme.title: The Media Show
programme.desc: Presenter of The News Agents podcast Lewis Goodall and Channel 4 News presenter Krishnan Guru-Murthy discuss whether traditional TV news remains fit for purpose in the digital and social media era. And as Blue Planet III returns to BBC One, we talk to Jack Bootle, the BBC's head of specialist factual commissioning. He explains how the series was made without generative AI and gives a behind-the-scenes peek into producing the natural history veteran David Attenborough.

programme.title: The Interface
programme.desc: The show that reaches through your screen, to tell you the tech stories that ready matter. Hosted by BBC technology journalist Thomas Germain and social media expert Professor Jessica Maddox, The Interface dives into the stories, trends, apps, gadgets, algorithms and internet obsessions shaping how we live, work, think and connect. From AI and influencers to memes, data leaks, cybersecurity and the weirdest corners of the web, The Interface explores what happens when technology collides with real life. Cutting through the hype, the hosts unpack the platforms, products and online phenomena that increasingly shape our choices, our culture and our sense of self - whether we like it or not! Sharp, insightful and often very funny, The Interface examines our relationship with technology in all its messy, brilliant, absurd and world-changing glory. Along the way, it tackles one of the biggest questions of our age: what kind of future are the likes of Elon Musk, Chat GPT and all the other Silicon Valley giants building, and does anyone really want to live there?

programme.title: US Midterm Elections 26
programme.desc: Live from Washington DC, Clive Myrie, Sumi Somaskanda and Caitríona Perry guide viewers through a decisive night in American politics with far-reaching implications for the world. As polls close and votes pour in across the country, the balance of power in Washington is at stake. Throughout the night, BBC News will bring viewers the latest results as they happen, along with expert analysis of the races, candidates and issues driving voters to the polls, from affordability and immigration to tariffs, international conflict and the growing impact of data centres on local communities. With correspondents reporting from across the United States and the world, plus Ros Atkins at the touchscreen breaking down turnout, voting trends and the shifting balance of power, BBC News will track every major development in real time.

programme.desc: Matt Tebbutt is joined by chefs Rick Stein and Dara Klein, and by special guest Stacey Dooley. Drinks expert Olly Smith picks the wines to go with the studio dishes, and there are some great moments from the BBC food archive.

programme.title: Simply Nigella
programme.desc: Nigella continues to show us that what and how we cook really can make us feel better and more alive. She introduces us to her favourite recipes for sharing with family and friends. Whether it's a tray of nourishing breakfast bars for those mornings you all need to grab and go; a supper of crunchy chicken cutlets that are just as much fun in the making as in the eating; or Nigella's latest addition to her 'Chocolate Cake Hall of Fame' - her stunning dark and sumptuous chocolate cake, every recipe is a guaranteed crowd pleaser. There's a pork bun feast, too. First inspired by a visit to a New York eatery, Nigella's succulent belly pork burgers - with their array of condiments and picky bits - are now a favourite DIY lunch when the hoards descend.

programme.title: Bargain Hunt

programme.title: The Football Interview
programme.desc: The Football Interview sees the biggest names in sport and entertainment join host Kelly Somers for bold, in-depth conversations about the nation’s favourite sport. We explore mindset and motivation, reflect on defining moments and career highs, and discuss personal insights. It’s a chance to show an honest, human and sometimes surprising side to familiar faces. At the heart of this is Kelly Somers – one of the most trusted, versatile and authentic voices in sports broadcasting. Kelly brings a brand of warmth and relatability that resonates with both athletes and audiences. What sets her apart is her ability to dig deeper with a sensitive approach, creating a space where athletes feel comfortable being open, honest and at times vulnerable. Each episode sees Kelly draw out stories and insight from the player behind the name about the beautiful game, their origins and values, and a look-ahead to the future from a sporting and personal perspective. She takes her subjects on a journey – and takes the viewer with her.

For her own project, Sarah has a collection of lampshades to get creative with – but will all three skip finds produce profits for their unsuspecting owners?

programme.title: Escape to the Country

programme.title: The Bidding Room
programme.desc: Nigel Havers presides as members of the public with interesting items to sell come face to face with five dealers who bid against each other to try to bag themselves a bargain. Before facing the dealers, each seller has their item valued by auctioneer Simon Bower. Simon also gives them top tips on the history and key characteristics of their piece, so that when they enter the bidding room, they have all the information they need to try to haggle the best possible price from the dealers. All the dealers are spending their own money but have no idea what the sellers have brought in.

programme.title: Bridge of Lies
programme.desc: Ross Kemp presents the quiz show where a team of four – in this episode, friends Ian, Kate, Paul and Suzy – take on the Bridge of Lies. One by one, they all face the Bridge, choosing who faces each crossing depending on the question category. Each crossing has 32 potential steps, including 22 truths and ten lies. They must cross the Bridge by stepping on the truths and avoiding the lies, earning money for each correct answer. Step on a lie and the Bridge will halve their money. Step on three lies, and they are out of the game. There is always a safe path across the Bridge. They just have to find it. Once they have each faced the Bridge on their own, those who have been successful will join forces to face the final crossing for a chance to take home the cash.

programme.desc: The story of Iranians who have lived through the most turbulent and traumatic of years, with widespread street protests, a brutal crackdown by the authorities and a war launched against Iran by the US and Israel. The film follows one mother who begins the year planning a future with her daughter, only to see it end with a promise to avenge her daughter’s death. After she publicly blamed the Iranian authorities, she was forced to flee the country and live in exile. A medic reveals how his life has changed after treating hundreds of protesters, many with gunshot wounds, while a man who also fled Iran in fear shares the last messages from a relative, sentenced to death. Filmed both inside and outside the country, this is the raw and uncompromising story of a year in Iran, told by some of the people who were there.

She reads the old folk bedtime horror stories, arranges late-night dances and euthanises them if they ask nicely. Into this secret world comes Paul, a vulnerable young man stuck stealing cars to repay a debt to crime boss Ma Baker. Paul is desperate to stay out of prison and needs a legitimate job to keep him safe, so he calls on his guardian angel - an irascible detective called Bunny Ryan. Bunny uses his personal history with the matron of Bridget’s nursing home to pull in a favour - a favour that will cost him dear. Throughout the night, BBC News will bring viewers the latest results as they happen, along with expert analysis of the races, candidates and issues driving voters to the polls, from affordability and immigration to tariffs, international conflict and the growing impact of data centres on local communities. With correspondents reporting from across the United States and the world, plus Ros Atkins at the touchscreen breaking down turnout, voting trends and the shifting balance of power, BBC News will track every major development in real time.

programme.title: The Repair Shop on the Road
programme.desc: Will and Dan tackle a scale model of the world’s only rotating boat lift: the Falkirk Wheel. There are missing cogs and broken bearings, while an underperforming motor demand precision repairs. In the barn, Dom entrusts Wappy - a soft toy that saw Robbie through life-saving treatment in Dundee - to Julie and Amanda for a sensitive rebuild, before Will swaps timber for silver as he makes a decorative bowl with celebrated silversmith Katie Watson.

programme.title: Our Lives
programme.desc: This Our Lives documentary tells the story of Boots and Beards, a Scots Asian-run hillwalking group helping people from ethnic minority backgrounds explore the great outdoors. We join the group as it gathers once again after a year in lockdown and prepares to celebrate its landmark 100th walk. We meet the group’s founders, Naveed Baksh and Kashif Butt, whose close friendship has been a driving force behind the success of the group. Their fortnightly hillwalks began as a way to spend more time with close friends and family, but have grown into a community event that has transformed lives. Naveed also travels to Fort William, the small Highland town where his parents first settled when coming to the UK. There, he’s joined by Kashif for a walk up Ben Nevis, the highest mountain in the country and the pair’s greatest hillwalking challenge to date.

programme.title: Mythland
programme.desc: Witches dominate popular culture, but behind the fantasy lies a brutal history of female persecution. Evelyn and Zara investigate the mysterious case of Lilias Adie, a local woman accused of witchcraft in Torryburn, Fife, in 1704 - with shocking results.

programme.title: Mythland
programme.desc: UFOs, alien encounters, government cover-ups and mysterious lights in the sky - the myths surrounding extraterrestrial life have fascinated us for decades. But where does the truth end and the legend begin? Zara and Evelyn head to Scotland’s infamous Falkirk Triangle, a UFO hotspot at the centre of extraordinary claims, to investigate why these stories take hold and whether there is any truth behind them. Meeting passionate UFO spotters, a sceptical academic and a former RAF press officer, they explore how science fiction, media hype and conspiracy theories have helped fuel our fascination with the unexplained. From claims of secret government files to the remarkable case of forestry worker Robert Taylor, whose alleged encounter in 1979 remains shrouded in mystery, Zara and Evelyn uncover the stories behind Scotland’s enduring UFO mythology. With eyewitness accounts, archive footage and intriguing forensic evidence, can Zara and Evelyn separate fact from folklore? Are these sightings misunderstood phenomena, myths that have taken on a life of their own, or evidence that we’re not alone?

programme.desc: Banjo's brought in to help two small businesses who survive by selling their produce via honesty boxes. Jamie and Mary live on the Isle of Mull. Jamie works full time catching lobsters, and Mary looks after their three children but also runs a small sandwich shop. Too busy to open the shop full time, they also sell their produce in an honesty box. They want Banjo’s help to make their box stand out and attract visitors. The other honesty box is in South Uist, in the Outer Hebrides. Donna works as a carer by day but also has a side hustle making ice cream. She currently runs her honesty box out of an old livestock trailer and wants Banjo to help her build something more imaginative and fun. Can his ambitious honesty boxes stand out in the crowd and please the clients?

programme.title: Designing the Hebrides
programme.desc: Artist Mike and his teacher wife Kate moved to Iona 20 years ago. They now run Iona Wool, which sells ethical local wool products. Their shop is functional but could do with some Banjo design magic. The beautiful colours of their stock mean that they don’t want much colour, which is a challenge for Banjo, whose designs are often dark and richly coloured. Banjo comes up with a modern Hebridean design idea which he hopes will keep selling the gorgeous woollens but also warm up the shop with some fun design features. Banjo heads to Glasgow to his favourite salvage shop and buys dozens of bobbins from old wool mills to help with his design. His trusty team of local tradespeople help him realise his design vision. Meanwhile, Lisa makes woollen lampshades, and Eoghan builds a woven timber wall to hide a changing room. With little time and only £6,000, will Banjo’s shop transformation hit the mark?

As his relationship with government, press and the public deteriorates, will he be forced to redefine the very nature of the Chief?

programme.title: Scotland’s Sacred Islands with Ben Fogle
programme.desc: Ben Fogle explores the ancient sea roads of the Inner Hebrides, with their evocative connections to 6th-century Christian missionaries. On Tiree, Ben explores 1,300-year-old temple ruins. Although remoteness and Viking raids have obscured its history, an undeniable air of spirituality remains. Ben visits crofter Rhoda Meek, who balances farming life with a day job in IT. Julie Clarke left her life in Glasgow to escape a difficult upbringing and moved to the Isle of Coll, transitioning to a woman in the process. The island and its people gave her confidence and support. A highlight of Ben’s journey is a visit to Iona, the island after which he named his daughter. Ben ends his pilgrimage staying overnight in a shepherd's hut.

programme.title: Paramedics on Scene
programme.desc: A Special Operations Response Team near Edinburgh are dispatched to a huge, potentially toxic fire on an industrial estate. They wait for news from the firefighters that everyone has made it safely out of the building. Meanwhile, another team are helping a concussed driver out of his car following a frightening collision at nighttime in Dunbartonshire. All the driver can remember is that the traffic lights were green. In Livingston, a son notices that his father is looking pale and faint, and helps him back to bed. The paramedics discover that the man has a dangerously low heart rate and blood pressure. An elderly lady who was due to go shopping with friends is found with a broken hip after a fall, and paramedics in Glasgow help a man suffering from severe alcohol withdrawal to safely detox.

programme.title: Mythland
programme.desc: Witches dominate popular culture, but behind the fantasy lies a brutal history of female persecution. Evelyn and Zara investigate the mysterious case of Lilias Adie, a local woman accused of witchcraft in Torryburn, Fife, in 1704 - with shocking results.

programme.title: Mythland
programme.desc: UFOs, alien encounters, government cover-ups and mysterious lights in the sky - the myths surrounding extraterrestrial life have fascinated us for decades. But where does the truth end and the legend begin? Zara and Evelyn head to Scotland’s infamous Falkirk Triangle, a UFO hotspot at the centre of extraordinary claims, to investigate why these stories take hold and whether there is any truth behind them. Meeting passionate UFO spotters, a sceptical academic and a former RAF press officer, they explore how science fiction, media hype and conspiracy theories have helped fuel our fascination with the unexplained. From claims of secret government files to the remarkable case of forestry worker Robert Taylor, whose alleged encounter in 1979 remains shrouded in mystery, Zara and Evelyn uncover the stories behind Scotland’s enduring UFO mythology. With eyewitness accounts, archive footage and intriguing forensic evidence, can Zara and Evelyn separate fact from folklore? Are these sightings misunderstood phenomena, myths that have taken on a life of their own, or evidence that we’re not alone?

programme.desc: Judith Ralston and Grado are out and about exploring Ayrshire and its islands. programme.title: OnlyFans: Inside the Machine
programme.desc: Behind the billion-pound success of OnlyFans lies a hidden ecosystem of exploitation. A BBC Current Affairs investigation uncovers allegations of exploitation, coercion and violence committed by some of the hundreds of agents who manage many of the platform’s creators as well as the potential for modern slavery. Through survivor testimony, undercover access to a managers’ chat forum and expert legal analysis, the film exposes an industry where young women are trapped, threatened and profited from - raising urgent questions about accountability at the heart of one of Britain's most lucrative tech companies.

programme.title: This Country

Vicky is super-picky, has a long list of unrealistic criteria for her perfect match, dumps guys for using the wrong emojis, analyses everything they do and walks out of 60 per cent of her dates. Tired of hearing about Vicky’s first date failures and delivering advice that gets ignored, Georgie calls on sex and relationships expert Oloni for an urgent intervention. Oloni wants Vicky to see where it's all going wrong, so she dishes out some cold, hard truths as she unpacks Vicky’s dating history and shows her some frank and honest video feedback from friends, family and even exes, to prove to Vicky that her bad dating behaviour needs a serious reboot. Oloni has to pull out all the stops to melt this ice queen as she sets Vicky up on a series of first dates that will challenge her behaviour and make her a better dater. Under the watchful eye of Oloni and Georgie, is Vicky ready for a change, will she give the guys a chance, be nice and let her guard down, or will she retain her ice queen crown?
